scope: MCP registration and package startup surface

applied_principles: prefer deletion/consolidation over new parallel authority
remove or demote superseded active mechanisms when safe
distinguish configured/declared capability from executed capability
add regression guards for testable cleanup
calibrate closure claims to inspected scope
maintenance_method.reason: This owner audit used the Universal maintenance method, but no distinct independent verifier was available to satisfy the current Universal action-receipt independent-verification requirement. The audit is durable owner maintenance evidence, not an independently attested Universal operational PASS.

findings.finding: Package startup pointed to continuity_plugin.py while AGENT_MANIFEST omitted that actual wrapper and static audit treated plugin_server.py as the sole MCP surface. Tool registration was split: plugin_server owned business tools while continuity_plugin monkey-patched summary behavior and added resumable discovery.
findings.risk: Future edits could update one surface but not the other, producing tool-inventory, Continuity metadata, or startup drift.

findings.finding: runner.AgentRuntime was exported from package __init__ and advertised as a runtime/state-machine entrypoint even though it only orchestrates injected StageExecutors and the repository contained no real live stage executor set.
findings.risk: A test/offline harness could be mistaken for hosted business execution or live-source wiring.

findings.finding: live_source_acquisition capability named source_contracts.py as executor_ref although source_contracts.py only defines P01-P09 metadata and preferred methods.
findings.risk: Contract existence could be mistaken for a native live adapter implementation or current-session source execution proof.

findings.finding: MCP audit tool descriptions used independent-audit wording while strict_isolated_auditor was explicitly DECLARED_ONLY/UNAVAILABLE.
findings.risk: Same-context GateDecision submission could be misread as independent assurance.

findings.finding: ashare_event_agent/adapters/mock.py contained only test stubs but lived inside the production package namespace.
findings.risk: Production package contents implied an adapter layer that did not exist and increased the chance of mock/test symbols leaking into runtime reasoning.

findings.finding: Canonical root references had two byte-identical distribution copies, but AGENT_MANIFEST documented only the package mirror and did not explicitly classify the Skill mirror.
findings.risk: Legitimate packaging duplication could be mistaken for multiple rule authorities, or a future mirror could drift without clear ownership semantics.

findings.finding: Continuity v2 / ChatGPT Library / legacy deployment assumptions and a specific 9/30 cassette promotion target remained in lower-authority code comments or design/deployment documents.
findings.risk: Future agents could infer obsolete storage, recovery, or promotion semantics from stale documents.

alternative_analysis.candidate: Keep continuity_plugin wrapper and simply document it better
alternative_analysis.reason: It preserves split registration/monkey-patch behavior and a second public startup surface without a unique responsibility.

alternative_analysis.candidate: Delete runner.py and all packaged reference mirrors
alternative_analysis.reason: runner.py still provides deterministic fail-closed injected-executor regression value; package references/policy are consumed by isolated wheel validation; Skill references are a distribution bundle. Their problem was role ambiguity, not existence.

alternative_analysis.candidate: Create a new supervisor/harness registry to reconcile surfaces
alternative_analysis.reason: Would add another authority layer. Existing plugin_server, AGENT_MANIFEST, capability manifest and static audit can own the invariant directly.

alternative_analysis.candidate: Collapse to one public MCP surface, demote reference harnesses, delete test-only package pollution, classify mirrors explicitly and add static/test guards
alternative_analysis.reason: Smallest safe consolidation that lowers authority count and capability ambiguity without removing useful test/packaging roles.

deleted_as_superseded_or_polluting.reason: Superseded second MCP/startup wrapper; Continuity metadata and resumable discovery now live directly in plugin_server.py.
Test-only mock executor leaked into production package; failure stub moved into tests/test_runner.py.

retained_with_reason.reason: Deterministic negative/fail-closed injected-executor harness remains useful for trajectory tests when its non-production role is explicit.
Isolated wheel CI consumes these to prove distribution completeness; they are not dead code.
Historical maintenance evidence is an engineering audit trail, not an active authority surface.
Simple plugin metadata; no conflicting runtime registration or authority semantics found.
Current authority/cutover semantics were aligned and did not reactivate legacy external control.

implemented_changes: plugin_server.py now owns the complete 25-tool MCP surface, Continuity metadata projection and resumable-task discovery directly
pyproject console script and mcp smoke launch plugin_server.py directly
AGENT_MANIFEST 1.1 declares one public runtime entrypoint and explicitly classifies runner and both distribution mirrors

EXECUTION_CAPABILITIES 1.1/profile 2 binds the state machine to plugin_server and classifies live source acquisition as EXTERNAL_SESSION_CONNECTORS with source_contracts as contract_ref, not executor_ref
audit tool descriptions and MCP instructions explicitly separate decision submission from independent-review assurance
test-only mock adapter removed from production package
Skill explicitly documents single runtime surface, harness/source-contract limits, generated mirrors and non-executable future architecture
deployment and Intelligence Core documents were recalibrated to current GitHub governance and evidence-gated Runtime/Core promotion semantics
static audit prevents recurrence of retired wrapper/mock, entrypoint drift, runner/source overclaim, mirror ambiguity and independent-audit wording drift
capability unit tests verify the single public entrypoint and external-source capability truth

complexity_efficiency_effect.reason_mirrors_retained: Both have explicit Skill/wheel distribution roles and byte-equality regression guards.

passed_steps: MCP Streamable HTTP smoke against plugin_server directly

assurance_boundary.proven: Repository-level consolidation and anti-regression for the inspected harness/Agent/Skill/MCP/capability/mirror/pollution surfaces, plus clean wheel/runtime startup at the validated behavioral head.
not_proven: global absence of every possible obsolete or redundant artifact outside the inspected repository surfaces

next_owner_hygiene_rule: When adding a harness, adapter, Skill mirror, deployment document or capability pointer, require a unique runtime/distribution responsibility and a mechanical consumer/evidence path. Configured names, contracts, wrappers and test harnesses must never be promoted to executed business capability by presence alone.
